name: Grand Hyatt Hong Kong
positioning: Harbourfront hotel on Hong Kong Island facing Victoria Harbour, with a self-contained spa, Plateau, on its 11th floor
best_for: Travelers who want Victoria Harbour views from their room or suite
Guests who want a spa retreat without leaving the city

facts.text: The hotel is on Hong Kong Island, facing Victoria Harbour.
The hotel is a 5-minute walk from Exit B3 of Exhibition Centre station on the East Rail Line.
Guestrooms and suites are designed to blend traditional and modern aesthetics in an elegant, residential style.
Many of the rooms and suites have views of Victoria Harbour.
The Grand Suite has a 180-degree view of Victoria Harbour and the Hong Kong skyline.
The Premier Suite overlooks the outdoor swimming pool and landscaped gardens.
Rooms have a glass-enclosed bathroom with a standalone tub.
Grand Club is a lounge exclusively for suite and club floor guests.
Plateau Spa treatments take place in private treatment rooms with en suite bathrooms.
The Fitness Centre offers complimentary active wear rental for guests.
One Harbour Road serves authentic Cantonese cuisine in a setting that evokes a 1930s Taipan's mansion.
Le Petit Chef's Dining Room offers an immersive 3D visual dining experience.

highlights.text: Plateau Spa on the 11th floor is a self-contained resort within the hotel, offering privacy and seclusion from the city.
Plateau rooms sit within the spa facility, with access to fitness studios, a garden and other recreation areas.
The Victoria Harbour Suite has 270-degree views of the Hong Kong skyline.
Grand Club serves all-day Champagne and evening cocktails with a panorama of Victoria Harbour through floor-to-ceiling windows.
The heated outdoor swimming pool on the 11th floor has views of the Central skyline.

considerations.text: The minimum age for check-in is 18.
Hong Kong International Airport is 35 kilometres away; by Airport Express, guests take the train to Hong Kong Station and then a five-minute taxi ride to the hotel.
WhataHotel notes the busy convention district location may not suit leisure-focused travelers.
